zh-CN.Define the Claim Before Evaluating the F: Define the Claim Before Evaluating the Finish
zh-CN.A coated board can repel a droplet while: A coated board can repel a droplet while still exchanging moisture with surrounding air. The research question is therefore not whether a finish works, but which transport process it changes under specified conditions. Hunt's Wood Handbook Chapter 16 [1] provides the finishing context, while Glass and Zelinka's Chapter 4 [2] explains wood–moisture relations. This article uses a deliberately simplified response model to distinguish response rate from final condition. It contains no coating comparison data. The model's constants are invented teaching inputs, so its curves cannot rank commercial finishes or establish an installation schedule.
zh-CN.Separate Liquid Water From Water Vapor: Separate Liquid Water From Water Vapor
zh-CN.The handbook treats liquid-water exposur: The handbook treats liquid-water exposure and water-vapor exchange as different aspects of moisture control. A finish's ability to limit one does not establish its performance for the other. Coating type, application, coverage, and the condition of the wood belong in the interpretation. This distinction supports a specific question for a product report: was the result measured during a liquid exposure, a humidity exposure, or another test? Record the exposure with the result. Repeating a broad waterproof claim without its test method can hide the exact property needed for the project.
zh-CN.A First-Order Model Makes the Distinctio: A First-Order Model Makes the Distinction Visible
zh-CN.For teaching only, suppose an average mo: For teaching only, suppose an average moisture value M follows M(t) = M∞ + (M0 − M∞) exp(−t/τ). Set the initial value M0 = 8% and an imposed destination M∞ = 12%. Assign response times τ = 2 days to case A and τ = 8 days to case B. Neither response time comes from wood or coating measurements. The model treats the piece as one uniform state, ignoring internal gradients, hysteresis, and changing surroundings. Its sole purpose is to show that two systems can approach the same imposed destination at different rates.
zh-CN.Calculate the Scenarios Without Rebrandi: Calculate the Scenarios Without Rebranding Them as Data
zh-CN.At day 2, the model produces 10.53% for: At day 2, the model produces 10.53% for case A and 8.88% for case B. At day 8, it gives 11.93% and 10.53%, respectively. Both tend toward 12% as time increases. A lower value during this constructed exposure therefore indicates a slower modeled response, not proof of permanent exclusion of moisture. If an actual coating changes additional material behavior, those effects would require another model and supporting evidence. The comparison table preserves the hypothetical status of the values so a reader cannot reasonably mistake them for a product trial.
zh-CN.Edges Create a Different Experimental Qu: Edges Create a Different Experimental Question
zh-CN.Imagine comparing two panels when one ha: Imagine comparing two panels when one has all edges treated and the other has a freshly machined edge. Even if both faces receive the same nominal coating, the exposure pathways differ. A proposed experiment should label face, edge, end-grain, and any penetrations separately. It should record the applied system, coat count, drying or cure interval, and the manufacturer's coverage guidance. An edge cut made after finishing belongs in the record. Otherwise a result attributed to a coating formula may actually reflect a specimen preparation difference that the experiment never controlled.
zh-CN.Plan a Controlled Comparison Instead of: Plan a Controlled Comparison Instead of a Demonstration
zh-CN.Use identified, matched specimens and as: Use identified, matched specimens and assign treatments before exposure. Include an appropriate control, a common conditioning history, and several independent pieces for each treatment. Record mass at scheduled times with a balance suitable for the intended change, and monitor temperature and humidity. A mass trajectory is an observation of that specimen under that exposure; it does not automatically distinguish coating absorption from wood absorption. Document how the method handles that ambiguity. Continue observations long enough to address the chosen question, and publish missing readings and any specimens removed because the finish was visibly damaged.
zh-CN.A finishing schedule should identify whi: A finishing schedule should identify which surfaces are coated before assembly, which become inaccessible, and which will be cut or drilled afterward. Keep joint bonding requirements separate from coating requirements so a glue surface is not accidentally treated as a finished face. A panel layout also needs the intended service environment and appropriate movement review. Even where a finish reduces short-term moisture fluctuations, the assembly still needs evidence for its service range. The companion equilibrium-moisture article explains why a room reading and a fixed waiting period cannot establish the material's present condition.
zh-CN.The teaching model resolves a logical er: The teaching model resolves a logical error: a slower response during an observation interval does not, by itself, establish a permanently sealed system. It does not predict real drying time, coating permeability, cupping, or service life. Those questions require identified materials, a relevant test method, and observations suited to the intended claim. A useful report would state the exposure, specimen preparation, measured response, and the time window before discussing practical implications. That makes a modest result usable, while leaving unanswered questions visible for the next experiment rather than concealing them behind a product label.
zh-CN.Name the liquid or vapor exposure being: Name the liquid or vapor exposure being discussed.
zh-CN.Record the full coating and edge-treatme: Record the full coating and edge-treatment system.
zh-CN.Keep the model's time constants labeled: Keep the model's time constants labeled hypothetical.
zh-CN.Review service movement and bonding surf: Review service movement and bonding surfaces separately.
zh-CN.What does a finish change about moisture: What does a finish change about moisture response, and what remains unproven by a dry-looking surface?
zh-CN.A coating can change transport without p: A coating can change transport without proving equilibrium, preventing every moisture pathway, or removing the need for movement accommodation.
